# Appendix

```{r data}
#| include: false

data_all <- read_rds("../data/data.rds")

females <- data_all |>
  filter(sex == "Female") |>
  filter_out(is.na(bred)) |>
  select(date, brood.spot, bred, year) |>
  mutate(year_c = (year - mean(year)) / 10) |> # decades from mean year, for interpretable logit-scale priors
  drop_na(brood.spot)

breeders <- females |>
  filter(bred == 1) |>
  drop_na(brood.spot)

females_no2007 <- females |> filter(year != 2007)

# Nólsoy only: all Mykines samples are from 2007 and 2008 (see manuscript)
females_nolsoy <- females |> filter(!year %in% c(2007, 2008))
```

```{r model-fit}
#| include: false

priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b"), # slopes, incl. brood.spot and interaction
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", coef = "year_c"), # skeptical prior on the trend
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept")
)

m01_prior <- brm(bred ~ year_c * brood.spot,
                 data = females,
                 family = bernoulli(),
                 prior = priors,
                 file = "../output/priors.rds",
                 file_refit = "on_change",
                 sample_prior = "only")

set.seed(42)  # pp_check simulates new data, so fix it for a stable figure
pp_prior <- pp_check(m01_prior, type = "stat", stat = "mean")

m01 <- brm(bred ~ year_c * brood.spot,
           data = females,
           family = bernoulli(),
           prior = priors,
           seed = 42,
           iter = 4000,
           cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1,
           chains = 6,
           sample_prior = "yes",
           file = "../output/m01.rds",
           file_refit = "on_change",
           silent = 2,
           save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE))

set.seed(42)  # pp_check simulates new data, so fix it for a stable figure
pp_model <- pp_check(m01, type = "stat", stat = "mean")
mcmc_model <- bayesplot::mcmc_trace(m01, regex_pars = "^b_", facet_args = list(ncol = 1))
loo_m1 <- loo(m01)

priors2 <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", coef = "year_c"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept")
)

m02 <- brm(brood.spot ~ year_c,
           data = breeders,
           family = bernoulli(),
           prior = priors2,
           seed = 42,
           iter = 4000,
           cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1,
           chains = 6,
           sample_prior = "yes",
           file = "../output/m02.rds",
           file_refit = "on_change",
           silent = 2,
           save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE))

set.seed(42)  # pp_check simulates new data, so fix it for a stable figure
pp_model2 <- pp_check(m02, type = "stat", stat = "mean")
mcmc_model2 <- bayesplot::mcmc_trace(m02, regex_pars = "^b_", facet_args = list(ncol = 1))
loo_m2 <- loo(m02)

m01_sens2007 <- brm(bred ~ year_c * brood.spot,
                     data = females_no2007,
                     family = bernoulli(),
                     prior = priors,
                     seed = 42,
                     iter = 4000,
                     cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1,
                     chains = 6,
                     sample_prior = "yes",
                     file = "../output/m01_sens2007.rds",
                     file_refit = "on_change",
                     silent = 2,
                     save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE))

set.seed(42)  # pp_check simulates new data, so fix it for a stable figure
pp_model2007 <- pp_check(m01_sens2007, type = "stat", stat = "mean")
mcmc_model2007 <- bayesplot::mcmc_trace(m01_sens2007, regex_pars = "^b_", facet_args = list(ncol = 1))
loo_sens2007 <- loo(m01_sens2007)

m01_sens_mykines <- brm(bred ~ year_c * brood.spot,
                        data = females_nolsoy,
                        family = bernoulli(),
                        prior = priors,
                        seed = 42,
                        iter = 4000,
                        cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1,
                        chains = 6,
                        sample_prior = "yes",
                        file = "../output/m01_sens_mykines.rds",
                        file_refit = "on_change",
                        silent = 2,
                        save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE))

set.seed(42)  # pp_check simulates new data, so fix it for a stable figure
pp_model_mykines <- pp_check(m01_sens_mykines, type = "stat", stat = "mean")
mcmc_model_mykines <- bayesplot::mcmc_trace(m01_sens_mykines, regex_pars = "^b_", facet_args = list(ncol = 1))
loo_sens_mykines <- loo(m01_sens_mykines)
```

```{r diagnostics-table}
#| include: false

diag_row <- function(fit, loo_fit, label) {
  fx <- summary(fit)$fixed
  tibble(
    Model = label,
    `Max $\\hat{R}$` = round(max(fx$Rhat), 3),
    `Min Bulk ESS` = format(round(min(fx$Bulk_ESS)), big.mark = ","),
    `Min Tail ESS` = format(round(min(fx$Tail_ESS)), big.mark = ","),
    `ELPD (SE)` = sub("^-", "−", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", loo_fit$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"], loo_fit$estimates["elpd_loo", "SE"])),  # proper minus sign
    `Eff. params (SE)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", loo_fit$estimates["p_loo", "Estimate"], loo_fit$estimates["p_loo", "SE"]),
    `Max Pareto *k*` = round(max(loo_fit$diagnostics$pareto_k), 2)
  )
}

diagnostics_table <- bind_rows(
  diag_row(m01, loo_m1, "M1: breeding status ~ year x brood patches"),
  diag_row(m02, loo_m2, "M2: brood patches ~ year (breeders only)"),
  diag_row(m01_sens2007, loo_sens2007, "M1, 2007 excluded"),
  diag_row(m01_sens_mykines, loo_sens_mykines, "M1, Mykines (2007–2008) excluded")
)
```

```{r tbl-diagnostics}
#| label: tbl-diagnostics
#| tbl-cap: "Convergence diagnostics (maximum $\\hat{R}$ and minimum bulk/tail effective sample size across fixed effects) and out-of-sample predictive fit (expected log pointwise predictive density (ELPD), effective number of parameters, and maximum Pareto *k* from approximate leave-one-out cross-validation) for the four fitted models."

knitr::kable(diagnostics_table, align = c("l", rep("r", 6)))
```
